title: Biased coordinate flip probability
statement: Let $p\in(0,1)$, let $f$ map the sign cube on $n$ coordinates to the two-element sign group, and let $i$ be a coordinate. The biased flip probability is the probability, under the product sign distribution with bias $p$, that flipping coordinate $i$ changes the value of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from the sign cube on $n$ coordinates to the two-element sign group
